page.notes: Running head is a heavy printed bar with partly illegible text; I could not read it. The handwritten "Aliud exemplum" in the left margin is manuscript, not print, so it is left out. The quotation marks » at the start of lines are printed in the text. Printed "s" is rendered as "s" throughout. Words split across lines with no printed hyphen (Gratidiani, Sergij, antè, exemplum) are written whole. The "ct" in "actione" is a ligature; I read it as ct with some uncertainty. The bottom marks are stains or show-through and are not transcribed.
